description.value: Papito's Pizza is a local pizza restaurant that has been serving the Kettle Valley area for over 20 years, situated on the main Highway 97 corridor through Lake Country. The menu runs well beyond pizza — wings, pasta, poutine, salads, and a broad roster of specialty pies — making it a solid stop for a hot meal on a long ride. Online ordering and everyday take-out specials make it convenient for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active business with a detailed menu and online ordering. A key discrepancy exists: OSM lists the phone as +1-250-766-3464 but the website prominently displays (250) 764-1990 — a different number — so the website value is used and the conflict flagged. Takeout is confirmed by the website's 'Everyday Take-Out Specials Available any day for pick-up' copy; vegetarian and gluten-free options are confirmed by the 'Vegetarian' pizza listing and 'Gluten Free (Medium only)' modifier; no evidence exists on the website for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-250-766-3464 but the website prominently shows (250) 764-1990. These differ in both the exchange (766 vs 764) and remaining digits. OSM value may be outdated or incorrect. Website number used as the primary value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizza restaurant on a major cycling corridor in Lake Country with confirmed takeout service and an accessible website; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian' specialty pizza (mushrooms, onion, green pepper, olives, tomato) and a 'Gluten Free (Medium only)' crust add-on; dairy-free cheese is also listed as an available topping
